summary: AXS summary views must preserve semantic firmware strings, zero-valued readings, the latest independently sampled values, and fields stored at either supported summary level.
reason: Dotted firmware versions cannot be JSON numbers, 0% battery is valid data, and summary records do not always carry every field at the same time or nesting level; incorrect assumptions can erase or undercount known values.
validated_outcome: Firmware versions retain every segment, zero readings remain present, newer partial summaries no longer erase known values, and wear counts fall back to top-level summary fields; regression tests plus Go test, vet, and build pass.
